processing: merrill-actions の右側の演奏姿勢だけ採用。原本1774x887から left1010 top0 width764 height887を切り出し、別工程で透明余白をtrim(threshold:10)、縦512px。投擲姿勢は左右の装具が不一致のため不採用。mushroom は透明余白を除き縦256px。road-artパイプラインでWebP化。

RIGHT hand bare. RIGHT CELL: sings with mouth open, dances raising one knee, her bare RIGHT fingers pluck strings on the BACK of LEFT forearm gauntlet, left hand naturally holds forearm before torso. No separate harp. Clear expressive two action poses, uncomplicated clean cel-shaded game art. True transparent RGBA outside figures, opaque interiors, no backdrop or ground shadow, no text or musical notes. Exactly two Merrill figures.
